items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the penal law, in relation to inciting violence against a police officer
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S2566

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the penal law, in relation to
inciting violence against a police officer

 PURPOSE :

Establishes a class D felony for the crime of inciting violence
against a police officer.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 1. The penal law is amended by adding new section 240.12,
establishing the crime of inciting violence against a police officer.

Section 2. This act shall take effect on the ninetieth day after it
shall have become law.

 JUSTIFICATION :

This legislation aims to protect and prevent crimes against those who
have made a career out of protecting the citizens of this state. In
recent months we have seen a surge in violent crimes committed against
on-duty police officers. Members of local policing communities have
become targets for violent offenders and we must act to curb this
trend with the proper classification of the crimes committed.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

S.5598 of 2015/2016

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect on the ninetieth day after it shall have
become law.
